Emergency Awesome New Videos https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FeOfhzu7ZdY&list=PLOIeYdZ3QczxQXxyV_2D8kuEs_QsuQIyJ&index=7

Covering New Avengers Doomsday Hidden Details, Russo Bros new Time Runs Out Material. More clues and Doctor Doom Backstory. Why Tobey Maguire fights Wolverine, Deadpool and the X-Men. Sadie Sink Jean Grey X-Men Ending Explained. How the ending sets up Sadie Sink's Jean Grey for all her future X-Men Movies, and her new MCU Origin Story. The Hulk Ending, and why Hulk also skips Avengers Doomsday, but returns during Avengers Secret Wars. Deadpool and Wolverine Return.

And what happens with Spider-Man 5 and other future Spider-Man movies. Tom Holland Spider-Man Evolution, Hulk Scenes Explained. Jon Bernthal Punisher. Tobey Maguire & Andrew Garfield Spider-Man Easter Eggs. Spider-Man vs Sadie Sink. Jean Grey New Powers Explained. New Spider-Man AI and Suit Tech Explained. Spider-Man vs Damage Control, X-Men Jean Grey, Bruce Banner Savage Hulk, Sadie Sink New Character, Spider-Man vs Punisher. Tom Holland and Jon Bernthal reunion. New Spider-Man Suit First Look. Hulk Announcement. Why Bruce Banner would help Spider-Man, Spider-Man vs Hulk, Spider-Man Movies previous references to The Hulk. The Scorpion Returns, Tombstone, Jackal and other new villains. Miles Morales Spider-Man Easter Eggs.

Spider-Man vs Sadie Sink Jean Grey, Jean Grey Phoenix Powers. Spider-Man Brand New Day Post Credit Scene & Avengers Doomsday Trailer Connection. Robert Downey Jr Doctor Doom, New Black Panther, X-Men, Doctor Strange, Avengers Secret Wars First Look, Battleworld MCU. Fantastic Four, Franklin Richards. Ian McKellen Magneto, Patrick Stewart Professor X, Kelsey Grammer Beast, Thor Returns, Mystique, Cyclops, Nightcrawler, Original X-Men.

Why Marvel is rebooting the MCU with Avengers 6 Secret Wars. What's going to change with all the Avengers, New Iron Man, X-Men Mutants like Wolverine, Deadpool, Fantastic Four, Ghost Rider, Spider-Man and other characters. Lots more Marvel Trailers coming Avengers Doomsday Trailer and Avengers Secret Wars videos.

In the action-thriller Ghost Soldier, Jim Caviezel stars as Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald, a solitary man with a mysterious past, living a quiet life off the grid in his hometown. But when a powerful foreign corporation descends on his community determined to seize his and his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz takes action — he’s actually a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with weapons no one has ever seen, a lifetime of lethal military training, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz becomes the one thing his enemies never anticipated: a one-man war they can’t win.

snippet.title: Black Myth: Zhong Kui – 15 Minutes Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
With blood beneath my blade, I paint new rouge upon my face,
An old friend visits, in a dream taking place.
Old faces, bygone deeds, have vanished from my sight,
Still, I remember every one, by day and through the night.
Those bound by love grow old; the righteous road runs long;
Today's notes of grace or grudge define not the final song.
Who says the Underworld is far away? 
All the better—once more I'll walk along.

Today, Game Science unveils a brand-new 15-minute gameplay trailer for Black Myth: Zhong Kui, the second title in the Black Myth series. The trailer offers a first look at the protagonist in combat, along with a glimpse of the story.

As the game is still in early development, all footage was captured in-game from a work-in-progress build running at a 21:9 aspect ratio. The final release may differ.

Official Website: https://gamesci.cn/zhongkui

"10,000 Miles From A Friend"
Written by Billy Strings (Apostol Publishing, BMI; administered by: Songs of Tuckaway Music, BMI and Sony Tree Publishing) and Aaron Allen (Joy Zone, ASCAP)

Rest stops, dives, and gift shops

I make my living hauling cargo
All around the whole damn country
I’ve been everywhere and barely left this rig boys 
I’ve been everywhere and barely left this rig 
 
I watch the white lines on the highway 
Try and slide right out of my way
I chase the road beyond that setting sun
And when it rises like a flower
I’m still just clocking hours
And I’ll see it rise again before I’m done boys

It’s Adderall and alcohol

Like my gut’s been full of buckshot 
And I feel ten thousand miles from a friend 
 
Late at night I miss my family 
And I struggle with my sanity 
On the moonless nights I swear I see the dog
There’s no restin’ for the innocent 
To hang on through the end of it
Just around the bend and through the fog

Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. snippet.title: Fuerza Regida - EXCESOS (Letra)
snippet.description:
🎵 Fuerza Regida - EXCESOS (Letra)

“EXCESOS” de Fuerza Regida es un tema con el sello distintivo del movimiento de corridos tumbados. La canción relata un estilo de vida rodeado de fiestas, lujos, noche y descontrol, retratando cómo se vive al límite para evadir las nostalgias o simplemente disfrutar de los logros y el éxito alcanzado.

➥ Fuerza Regida:
https://www.instagram.com/fuerzaregida/
https://www.facebook.com/fuerzaregidaoficial/
https://www.tiktok.com/@fuerzaregida

➥ Escucha Nuestra Playlist de Spotify!:
https://open.spotify.com/playlist/7iUQLvlRuKvVdZ1yDhmH6H?si=19a494afbd454b8c
➥ Escucha Nuestra Playlist de Youtube!:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLzUy9qQrjQ34Cy6LskeRlvu4sTBYhkBUw&si=GbkIvDRRAN_fLth4

🔔 Activa las notificaciones para enterarte de los vídeos nuevos!

Espero que te haya gustado nuestro video!

📝 Letra:

Ando como quiero
Destapo botellas
Tú ya andas con otro
Ni modo, qué pena

Creí serías la buena
Me voy, te dejo huella
Sí, estás bonita y todo
Pero hay más culos que estrellas

Me voy pa' la Capi
Los plebes me esperan
Saben si hay mucho verbo
Si hacen lo que quieran

Soy adicto a la feria
Polvo pa' que amanezca
Hoy dejo la tristeza
Gastando paquitas gruesas

Y mientras llega
Mi persona favorita
Seguiré con mi loquera
Los excesos, las morritas

Mami, yo nunca he tenido prisa
Porque ahorita vivo como artista
Prendan luces, cámaras y acción
Hay bellеzas en cada rincón

Fuerza Regida
Como siempre

Por el quemacocos
Les vuela el pelo a las güeras
Son muy sexy, beliconas
Con corridos se alebrestan

Estas Barbies solo piden fiesta
Yo soy el papi que las calienta
Mi lenguaje es pura seducción
Aunque pa'l amor, no sirvo yo

Y mientras llega
Mi persona favorita
Seguiré con mi loquera
Los excesos, las morritas

Mami, yo nunca he tenido prisa
Porquе ahorita vivo como artista
Prendan luces, cámaras y acción
Hay bellеzas en cada rincón

(Y hay más culos que estrellas, mija)
(Acuérdense de eso)

Widely regarded as the most successful region in international VALORANT competition, VCT Americas is home to world-class talent, championship-winning veterans, and the latest generation of emerging stars. The region also boasts the reigning Masters London champions and the current VALORANT Champions winners.
Now, the stakes are higher than ever. Every team enters Stage 2 with one objective: secure a spot at VALORANT Champions Shanghai.
Leviatán enters Stage 2 riding high after its Masters London triumph. NRG is ready to remind the world why it has long been considered a global powerhouse. Meanwhile, G2 Esports aims to defend its VCT Americas crown and add another championship to its trophy case.

snippet.title: I Beat Valheim with just my Fists... (movie)
snippet.description:
Check out my AWESOME mouse mat made in collaboration with Epic Desk. I had a blast making it with them and I hope you guys enjoy it! https://epicdesk.shop/products/jakks-frosthold-gaming-desk-mat

One of the most underpowered weapon skills in VALHEIM is of course Fists. There only being 3 weapons that use the fist skill in the ENTIRE game... So is it even possible to beat all 7 bosses by just punching them? Well that's what I spent over 55 hours trying to find out. From punching grizzly bears over 200 times to spending hours building a large river fort, this run was very fun :).

snippet.title: THE FIRST LOCKDOWN GAME ON NBA 2K27…..HE RAGE QUIT
snippet.description:

In this video, I’m breaking down everything I experienced with defense in NBA 2K27 — what I LOVE, what I DON’T like, steals, bumps, movement, contests, blocks and how lockdowns are feeling before the game officially releases.
